stage: DESIGN PRE for unattended automatic recovery
design_conditions: Keep a single logical observation session and CSV reader until explicit stop.
Retry only typed proven read-only/transport/Excel faults, with bounded backoff.
Retain immutable workbook bytes validated before the first controller for both heaters and every recovery.
Verify retirement of owner, abort, reader, PowerShell, owned Excel handle and temp resources; unknown ownership prevents replacement.
Retirement fence also applies across operator session replacement.
Discard old results; require validated current context and a baseline followed by a different fresh layer.
Preserve pinned job authorization and per-job/channel admission watermarks across transport retries.
Invalid thermometer markers are not physical temperatures; integrity/conflict rows cannot be dropped to fake recovery.
Uncertain edit/Save and generic formula/protocol/integrity faults retain a sticky IR barrier with observation continuing.
Confirmed settings alone cannot prove an unconfirmed queued Save was cleared.
distribution_approval: Requires final source and exact-artifact independent POST review.
